description: Emperor angelfish ( Pomacanthus imperator ), Red Sea, Egypt. It is a reef-associated fish that can reach a length of up to 40 centimetres (16 in). The emperor angelfish is found at depths between 1 and 100 metres (3.3 and 328.1 ft) and is native to the Indian and Pacific Oceans, from the Red Sea to Hawaii and the Austral Islands.
